requirements.requirement: Users need the ability to access the app's queue features without being blocked by mandatory paywalls after free trials or sign-in failures that block usage entirely.
example_quotes: No longer can use without log in. I used to use this app to sign in to my medical lab for bloodwork. It was helpful because it showed how many people were waiting. Now I can no longer use it. To get a log in you have to pay now after a 14 day free trail. Not happy

requirements.requirement: The app should operate reliably across devices and prevent crashes during core queue-management actions.
example_quotes: App won't load. App won't load on my iphone all of a sudden. Works on my iPad. Seems this app doesn't get updated much either.
when I make a custom queue and select it within the app, instant crash.

requirements.requirement: Users need the ability to customize visible information fields and privacy settings, such as hiding phone numbers and selecting displayed customer details in queue previews.
example_quotes: I really wish you could take away displaying peoples phone numbers. Maybe give us some more settings within the app that enable personalizing.
it would be nice to see a feature where we can select which fields you can see in the preview of the customer's information, that way I wouldn't have to open it up every time.

requirements.requirement: The app should accurately display real-time wait times and eliminate mandatory ads before revealing booking status, ensuring transparent appointment management.
example_quotes: it had the audacity to pop up and tell me that it would be at least 20 more minutes before my turn.
you still get to wait, and when you book, you'll have to wait for a tiresome lengthy loud noisy ad before even knowing about your booking status.

requirements.requirement: The app should accurately reflect business operating hours and prevent scheduling appointments on days or holidays when the business is closed.
example_quotes: The app won't let me--just keeps telling me that they're closed right now.
Wish it would not allow you to book an appointment on days not open.

requirements.requirement: Users need the ability to view and select from available businesses and queue options upon opening the app.
